scope: Bounded backtest continuation. One new economically motivated hypothesis: slower 120/60-bar Donchian may reduce fee-consuming turnover versus the unchanged20/10 rule. No parameter optimizer or repeated adjustment after results. No live deployment or financial authority.
signal_definition: Completed close above the high of the previous N bars enters; completed close below the low of the previous M bars exits. N/M are20/10 and120/60 on4h candles. Same existing FixedSignals sizing, risk exits and next-bar fill adapter. Exactly128 complete warmup bars per window.
market_selection: Chosen before returns from the previous study's documented continued data coverage, not highest profit. BNB/AVAX were excluded from this new-window study because their downloaded feeds ended in March2026; keep that limitation, not a negative performance conclusion.

windows.class: Previously seen continuous-account diagnostic; no quarter resets
New performance-evaluation window, cold-start100 account; only15days, NOT prospective service evidence or proof of durable profit

data_policy: Reuse hash-verified old native4h cache for old windows; use a separately saved fresh feed for later_15d, without revising past records. No filling of gaps. End exclusive; no incomplete final candle. The first October1boundary bar may have appeared in older raw API responses but was excluded from all prior performance windows; do not call all raw prices globally untouched. A missing request/window becomes BLOCKED/SKIPPED, not flat performance.
cost_limit: Two preregistered illustrative sensitivities, NOT independently calibrated AMM/router/network costs. No claim to solve Issue6 or permission/issuer/route risks.
controls: Initial100;20%equity target per order with25cap,10reserve,5minimum; one long position; existing3%daily/10%drawdown/5%position close-bar risk logic; cap2entries/day, no quota, no leverage/top-up. Risk thresholds do not guarantee limits in gaps. Profits retained and affect sizing. Final liquidation scheduled before last bar open. Cash and20%-initial hold benchmarks included.
qualification: Even positive15day results cannot pass legacy90day/100trade planning gates. Do not declare financialGO. Compare old-window robustness and new-window sign/trade count, cost and drawdown. Report all cases. No new return target or fitting based on final window; previous failed screen remains failed.
tests_before_execution: Slow signal equals explicit rolling prior120/60 extremum logic
Future price changes leave earlier signals unchanged
Insufficient warmup produces no new signal
Per-run ledgers reconcile and only causal entries/exits occur
deliverables: Full96-row results CSV, valid ledger summaries, data hashes, tests, equivalentFA/EN report, preserved old code/results and a separate draftPR. Partial output if data unavailable; never fabricate a run or return.
